clinical_sibling_association.description: ProteinGym ClinVar single-substitution validation: benign variants should retain within-family unit substitutions more often than pathogenic variants.

benign_same_sibling_rate.description: Rate at which benign substitutions keep the mutated unit in the same discovered family when token boundaries are unchanged.

pathogenic_same_sibling_rate.description: Rate at which pathogenic substitutions keep the mutated unit in the same discovered family; lower values preserve label separation.

benign_pathogenic_gap.description: Difference between benign and pathogenic same-family substitution rates.

benign_pathogenic_log_ratio.description: Log enrichment of benign over pathogenic same-family substitution rates, discouraging uniformly inflated sibling rates.

benign_same_idx.description: Fraction of benign substitutions whose token boundaries remain comparable before and after mutation.

pathogenic_same_idx.description: Fraction of pathogenic substitutions whose token boundaries remain comparable before and after mutation.

minimum_same_idx.description: Lower of the benign and pathogenic boundary-preservation rates, penalizing methods that make one label mostly unscorable.

family_coverage.description: Fraction of vocabulary entries participating in explicit parent or mutated-family structure.

vocab_size.description: Vocabulary size penalty to discourage gains from expanding the token budget.

dms_sibling_association.description: ProteinGym human DMS single-substitution validation: positive/high-fitness variants should retain within-family unit substitutions more often than negative/low-fitness variants.

positive_same_sibling_rate.description: Rate at which positive or high-fitness DMS substitutions keep the mutated unit in the same discovered family when token boundaries are unchanged.

negative_same_sibling_rate.description: Rate at which negative or low-fitness DMS substitutions keep the mutated unit in the same discovered family; lower values preserve fitness-bin separation.

positive_negative_gap.description: Difference between positive and negative DMS same-family substitution rates.

positive_negative_log_ratio.description: Log enrichment of positive over negative DMS same-family substitution rates, discouraging uniformly inflated sibling rates.

positive_same_idx.description: Fraction of positive DMS substitutions whose token boundaries remain comparable before and after mutation.

negative_same_idx.description: Fraction of negative DMS substitutions whose token boundaries remain comparable before and after mutation.

minimum_same_idx.description: Lower of the positive and negative boundary-preservation rates, penalizing methods that make one fitness bin mostly unscorable.

family_coverage.description: Fraction of vocabulary entries participating in explicit parent or mutated-family structure.

vocab_size.description: Vocabulary size penalty to discourage gains from expanding the token budget.

vocabulary_structure.description: Vocabulary-level structure at 6400 units: the learned vocabulary should allocate most units to mutation-linked families while preserving the fixed vocabulary budget.

family_coverage.description: Fraction of vocabulary entries participating in explicit parent or mutated-family structure.

mutated_vocab_fraction.description: Fraction of vocabulary entries recorded as mutation-derived family members.

parent_vocab_fraction.description: Fraction of vocabulary entries recorded as family parents.

family_count.description: Number of multi-member families, discouraging a trivial genealogy with only one or a few giant families.

mean_family_size.description: Average size of multi-member families, rewarding non-trivial family expansion across the vocabulary.

largest_family_fraction.description: Fraction of the vocabulary occupied by the largest family, penalizing collapsed all-in-one genealogies.

vocab_size.description: Vocabulary size penalty to discourage gains from expanding the token budget.
